general: Only when the source shows an off-white panel inset on a #f4ead8 cream surround, keep the panel at approximately 90% of the canvas width and let the cream surround absorb extra canvas space; otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows a product photo on the right inside the panel, keep the photo at approximately 54% of the canvas width and 63% of the canvas height anchored to the top-right and let the photo absorb size changes before fixed-size text elements; otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows a headline in the left column slightly overlapping the left edge of the photo, keep the headline left-aligned at an approximately 10% left inset within an approximately 32% wide column; otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows the LUMA wordmark at the top-left above the headline, keep it at approximately 11% of the canvas width aligned to the same left edge as the headline; otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows a gold #c9a24a CTA button below the photo, keep the button at approximately 36% of the canvas width and 7% of the canvas height centered within the panel; otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows a small gold price badge overlapping the bottom-left inside the photo, keep the badge at approximately 9% of the canvas width and 5% of the canvas height at that photo corner; otherwise keep the source structure.
never: Never add extra CTA buttons, price badges, promotional bands, or tabs not visible in the source.
Never add additional logos, wordmarks, frames, or borders beyond the cream surround and off-white panel visible in the source.
Never add extra products, text blocks, or decorative elements not visible in the source.
text: Visible text is English in Latin script, with the uppercase LUMA wordmark in small dark lettering at the top-left.
The headline is large dark #2b2b2b sans-serif, left-aligned in the left column over multiple short lines, and larger than all other text.
CTA text is white and centered inside the gold button, smaller than the headline.
Subtext below the CTA is small dark #2b2b2b, centered, and smaller than the CTA text.
Price badge text is dark, centered on gold, and smaller than the CTA text.
